description: Golden eval for the A2 Terms agent (lib/tnc + agents/terms). Each case is a real reward's free-text T&Cs (from prisma/seed.ts) with the critical typed rules the parser must extract. Scoring focuses on the numeric predicates (min_spend_usd, flat_off_usd, percent_off, max_discount_usd) and the boolean constraints — these are what the optimizer consumes and what the grounding guard protects. Category/merchant phrasing is checked loosely (substring, case-insensitive).

scoring.note: A case passes if every expected numeric predicate is present with the exact value, every expected boolean constraint is present, and assertGrounded() passes against termsRaw.
